layout_and_spacing.section_rhythm: pt-8 (strict rule: no bottom padding between sections, preserve visual density)
layout_and_spacing.bottom_spacing: pb-24 (MUST include to coexist with existing sticky bottom nav)
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for structural cards

ProfileHeaderCard.layout: bg-white border-[#E5E2DC] border rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 flex items-center gap-4 relative shadow-sm
ProfileHeaderCard.details: Avatar image (rounded-full, w-16 h-16 object-cover border border-[#E5E2DC]), user name (h2), phone number (small, muted text). 'Member' badge (bg-[#F59E0B]/10 text-[#F59E0B] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider absolute right-4 sm:right-6 top-6). 'Edit Profile' button underneath badge or as an icon in top right.

QuickActionGrid.details: Bento-style tiles for: Orders, Returns, Addresses, Wishlist, Wallet, Coupons, Support, Settings.
QuickActionGrid.tile_style: bg-white border-[#E5E2DC] border rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 hover:border-[#0A1F5C] hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer relative
QuickActionGrid.icon_style: lucide-react icons, size 24 or 28, color #0A1F5C, stroke-width 1.5
QuickActionGrid.badge_style: Absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-[#E68910] text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow-sm ring-2 ring-white (only render if count > 0)

RecentOrdersPreview.layout: bg-white border-[#E5E2DC] border rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 pt-8 mt-8 shadow-sm
RecentOrdersPreview.details: Header 'Recent Orders' (h2). Stack of up to 3 order items. Each item: flex row, product thumbnail (w-14 h-14 rounded-xl bg-[#FDFBF7] object-cover border border-[#E5E2DC]), order status (Saffron if pending/transit, Navy if delivered), date. Divider borders between items (border-b border-[#E5E2DC]).

InlineEditableSections.details: Use shadcn/ui collapsibles/accordions or conditional rendering for inline forms to prevent navigation away from the dashboard. Address list: vertical stack of white cards with edit/remove buttons.

LogoutControl.details: Ghost button, text-[#E68910] hover:bg-[#E68910]/10 rounded-full px-6 py-2 transition-colors font-medium.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a mobile-first 'My Account' dashboard matching major E-commerce apps (like Myntra/Ajio).
DO NOT invent new colors. Strictly adhere to the tokens defined in `color_palette_tokens`.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit `data-testid` attributes.
Implement a bottom padding (`pb-24` on the main container) to account for the existing sticky bottom nav.
All section spacings must strictly use `pt-8` with no bottom margins or paddings to maintain the required vertical rhythm.
Use `lucide-react` for all iconography to maintain a clean, consistent stroke aesthetic.
Use the exact image URLs provided in `media` for placeholders. Do not use placehold.it or via.placeholder.com.
